submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One independent1254x1254 RGBA transparent animation frame. Image1 is exact15 water-dragon-scholar edit target, preserve its native canvas and character scale. Image2 is CURRENT09 archer same-direction movement-structure reference ONLY, not identity/clothing/weapon. Image3 identity and image4 approved paint/material finish. Keep15 blue/ivory/gold robe, navy bun and blue tassels, white trousers, bluegold boots, one fan held by anatomical RIGHT hand and LEFT hand empty. Preserve head, torso, camera, hair, face, sleeve and robe motion except named local repair. No whole-body shift/rescale/recenter, no mirrored frames or pasted cutouts. No ground, cast shadow, particles, text or effects. FRONT view running SOUTH. The support LEFT leg is screenRIGHT; the other knee rises at screenLEFT. Only redraw support screenRIGHT knee/shin/ankle/boot into forward-pass support: reduce knee bend slightly after compression, but plant the shoe flat near sourcefloor y1191. The original front boot exposes a broad oval outsole like a forward kick. Rotate the sole DOWN to ground and show BLUE VAMP and thin gold sole rim, not broad brown underside. Its heel-to-toe long axis is straight SOUTH toward camera, never angled outward. Preserve its lowest pixel aroundy1191 by adjusting lower-shin length naturally, not by lifting shoe when rotating it. Keep rising screenLEFT knee/foot, all upper-body, arms and fan exactly original. Image2 same support/pass structure.
